en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. People walk along the sidewalks in early 20th‑century clothing, and several horse‑drawn carriages travel on the street beside tram tracks. At the far end of the street are trees and ornate buildings with towers and spires. The caption at the top reads "Freiberg i. Sa. — Poststraße." indicating the scene is Poststraße in Freiberg.
